description:
❤️🌸 Project Umeed – A Small Gift of Dignity 🌸❤️

Dear Rotarians & RCMMS Family,

Dignity lies in the little things we often take for granted. Through Project Umeed – A Small Gift of Dignity, we provided essential hygiene clothing and sanitary napkins to 300 women at the Mental Hospital, Thane, promoting their comfort, personal hygiene and well-being.

🗓 Date: Thursday, 29th October 2026
🕐 Time: 1:00 PM onwards
📍 Venue: Mental Hospital, Thane

👩‍⚕️ Project Chairperson: Dr. Aparna Padgaonkar

🌟 Special Mention & Gratitude

Our heartfelt appreciation to Bhavesh Thakkar, Trupti Shah, Jagruti Parekh, Swati Apte and Mamata Nakman for their valuable support and contribution towards making this meaningful initiative possible.

We thank all the Rotarians who contributed for this project to raise
&1,00,000/-

Regards,
Rtn. Amit Gupta – President
Rtn. Sonal Saxena – Secretary
Non-Medical Team
Rotary Club of Mumbai Mulund South
